Editor.Title: Particle Light Editor
Scanner.Save.Tooltip: Save scanner options and all edited particle lights.
Scanner.Defaults.Tooltip: Restore default scanner and association options.
Scanner.Selection.Info: Changes apply immediately. Save them to restore after loading.
Scanner.Filter.Tooltip: Search the object text or Form ID shown in the list.
Scanner.OpenAfterConsole.Tooltip: The console-selected particle light always appears in the combo when the console closes. Enable this to also open its editor window.
Scanner.PeriodicScanning.Tooltip: Zero disables periodic scanning. Cell changes and manual rescans still refresh immediately.
Scanner.Cache: Current cache: {0} lights from {1} cell references and {2} placed light sources.
Scanner.Association.Range.Tooltip: Maximum world-space distance between a particle light and a placed Skyrim light source for association. Increasing it can match more lights, but values that are too high may associate unrelated nearby sources.
Scanner.Association.RadiusInfluence.Tool: Tie-breaker used when multiple light sources are nearby. Zero uses distance only; higher values prefer sources whose light radius is more similar to the particle radius. This does not change either radius.
Console.NoReference: No reference is selected in the console.
Console.NoLights: Reference {0:08X} has no particle lights inside the current detection range.
Console.SelectedOne: Selected the particle light owned by reference {0:08X}.
Console.SelectedMany: Selected Particle Light 1 of {0} owned by reference {1:08X}.
Editor.NoLights: No editable particle lights are inside the current detection range.
Editor.Unavailable: The selected particle geometry is no longer editable.
Editor.Scope.Tooltip: Category scopes affect color, opacity, intensity, and proportional radius. Local position and enabled state always affect only this light.
Editor.Scope.Category.Tooltip: Choose which category the current scope edits. This does not change the selected mesh's category.
Editor.Scope.Assigned: Assigned the selected mesh to the target category.
Editor.Scope.Assign.Tooltip: Explicitly reclassify every instance using the selected mesh. Use this only when automatic classification is wrong.
Editor.Scope.ChooseCategory: Choose a target category before using a category scope.
Editor.Scope.Affected: Affected particle lights in the current cache: {0}
Editor.Enabled.Label: Particle light enabled
Editor.Enabled.Off: Particle light disabled; appearance and geometry controls are locked.
Editor.Enabled.Tooltip: Show or hide only the selected particle-light geometry. It remains available in the editor while disabled.
Editor.Radius.Tooltip: Category scopes preserve each light's relative size by applying the selected light's radius ratio.
Editor.Position.Updated: Local position updated for this light.
Editor.Position.Tooltip: Local position always changes only the selected light because different meshes use different pivots.
Editor.Reset.Property.Tooltip: Reset {0} for the active edit scope.
Editor.Copy.Success: Copied color, opacity, intensity, and radius scale.
Editor.Copy.Failure: Could not copy the selected light edits.
Editor.Copy.Tooltip: Copies color, opacity, intensity, and radius scale.
Editor.Paste.Success: Pasted color, opacity, intensity, and radius scale.
Editor.Paste.Failure: Some copied edits could not be pasted.
Editor.Paste.Tooltip: Paste the copied appearance and radius scale into the active edit scope.
Editor.Reset.Light.Tooltip: Restore the selected particle light to its original runtime values.
Editor.Reset.Scope.Tooltip: Remove the active category rule and reveal any more-specific saved edits.
Editor.Save.Failure: Could not save changes to disk.
Editor.Save.Tooltip: Save every edited particle light and the current menu options.
Editor.Status.Disabled: Appearance and geometry edits are unavailable while the light is disabled.
Editor.Status.ResetHint: Per-property reset uses the active edit scope.
Tools.Save.Tooltip: Save visualization, overlay, and logging options.
Tools.Defaults.Tooltip: Restore default visualization, overlay, and logging options.
Tools.Diagnostics.ShowMatched: Show lights matched to nearby sources
Tools.Diagnostics.Rescan.Tooltip: Discard the current scene cache and scan the attached cell again.
Tools.Logging.Level.Tooltip: Set the minimum severity written to the Particle Light Editor log. Debug includes canvas diagnostics.
